zh_quote_records.quote: 站在成熟植株旁边[右键点它](https://steamcommunity.com/app/413150/discussions/0/1849197902668085831/#c1849197902669410411)
一株[防风草](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/index.php?title=Parsnip&oldid=191123)浇水长 4 天，才会出现可以收获的图像。
一株[南瓜](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/index.php?title=Pumpkin&oldid=194726)浇水长 13 天，才会出现可以收获的图像
像[蓝莓](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/index.php?title=Blueberry&oldid=192090)（Blueberry）这种会多次收获的作物，要 13 天才第一次成熟。
[作物必须每天浇水，才能按最快速度生长](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/index.php?title=Crops&oldid=193979)
[X 和右键映射成同一个 Check/Do Action](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/index.php?title=Controls&oldid=192481)
[左键和 C](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/index.php?title=Controls&oldid=192481)绑定的是使用工具或放置物品。
[作物生长日历](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/index.php?title=Crop_Growth_Calendars&oldid=189875)，只收一次的地块要整个季节都有产出，是按收获当天重新播种并浇水来算的。
[按住右键，并且鼠标不要靠近角色](https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/pc-controls-vs-mobile.8990/post-53699)
[X 映射成右键](https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/pc-controls-vs-mobile.8990/post-53699)
另外一些作物必须用普通[镰刀](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/index.php?title=Scythe&oldid=171696)来收，例如苋菜、甘蓝菜和小麦。
[甘蓝菜要用镰刀或更好的镰刀来收](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/index.php?title=Kale&oldid=192520)
[纤维种子要用镰刀来收](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/index.php?title=Fiber_Seeds&oldid=193587)
[未碾米要用镰刀来收](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/index.php?title=Unmilled_Rice&oldid=194130)
[先选中镰刀，再使用它](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/index.php?title=Mobile_Controls&oldid=189843)
[铱镰刀](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/index.php?title=Iridium_Scythe&oldid=186836)是 1.6 耕种精通（Farming Mastery）给的那把镰刀。挥过的范围内，能收耕地上长出来的作物，普通作物也包括在内。
会掉落[15 到 21 个普通品质的物品](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/index.php?title=Crops&oldid=193979#Giant_Crops)。巨大作物换季不会死，所以可以留在田里，等到你准备砍的时候再砍。
[青豆、啤酒花和葡萄](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/index.php?title=Crops&oldid=193979#Trellis_Crops)（Green Bean、Hops、Grape）长在棚架上。活着的棚架走不穿，所以每株都要有一格能站在旁边。植株死了以后，那一格就可以走过去。
[不再当季的作物会在第 1 天枯萎](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/index.php?title=Crops&oldid=193979)，并留下枯株
ConcernedApe，星露谷物语新闻素材截图。
ConcernedApe，星露谷物语新闻素材截图。

en_quote_records.quote: stand beside a mature plant and [right-click it](https://steamcommunity.com/app/413150/discussions/0/1849197902668085831/#c1849197902669410411)
A [parsnip](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/index.php?title=Parsnip&oldid=191123) takes 4 days of watered growth to reach its harvest sprite.
A [pumpkin](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/index.php?title=Pumpkin&oldid=194726) takes 13 days of watered growth to reach its harvest sprite
For multi-harvest crops like the [blueberry](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/index.php?title=Blueberry&oldid=192090), plants take 13 days to reach maturity.
[crops must be watered every day for maximum growth](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/index.php?title=Crops&oldid=193979)
[X is mapped to the same Check/Do Action](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/index.php?title=Controls&oldid=192481) as right-click
[left-click and C](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/index.php?title=Controls&oldid=192481) are bound to using tools or placing items.

[crop growth calendars](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/index.php?title=Crop_Growth_Calendars&oldid=189875), keeping single-harvest plots productive throughout the season assumes seeds are replanted and watered on the day of harvest.
[hold right-click with the mouse not near your character](https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/pc-controls-vs-mobile.8990/post-53699)
[X is mapped to right-click](https://forums.stardewvalley.net/threads/pc-controls-vs-mobile.8990/post-53699)
A standard [scythe](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/index.php?title=Scythe&oldid=171696) is required for certain other crops, such as amaranth, kale, and wheat.
[Kale is harvested with a scythe or better](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/index.php?title=Kale&oldid=192520)
[fiber seeds are harvested with the scythe](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/index.php?title=Fiber_Seeds&oldid=193587)
[unmilled rice is harvested with a scythe](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/index.php?title=Unmilled_Rice&oldid=194130)
[select the scythe before you use it](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/index.php?title=Mobile_Controls&oldid=189843)

The [iridium scythe](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/index.php?title=Iridium_Scythe&oldid=186836) is the 1.6 Farming Mastery scythe. Within its swing it harvests crops grown on tilled soil, including regular crops.

drops [15 to 21 normal-quality items](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/index.php?title=Crops&oldid=193979#Giant_Crops). A giant crop does not die when the season changes, so it can stay in the field until you are ready to cut it.

[Green bean, hops, and grape](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/index.php?title=Crops&oldid=193979#Trellis_Crops) grow on a trellis. You cannot walk through a living trellis, so each plant needs a layout that lets you stand on a neighboring tile. After the plant is dead, you can walk through that tile.
[crops that are no longer in season wither on the 1st](https://stardewvalleywiki.com/index.php?title=Crops&oldid=193979) and leave dead stalks

audit_records.title: 星露谷物语怎么收作物：徒手、镰刀或斧头
audit_records.h1: 星露谷物语怎么收作物：徒手、镰刀或斧头
audit_records.description: 防风草和南瓜用右键或 X 徒手收，甘蓝菜和小麦用镰刀割，巨大作物用任意斧头砍三下。
